risk_note: RV2 (funds table). Migration 0122 adds one empty table app.union_receipts with named constraints, two list indexes and grants: couli_app SELECT, INSERT and UPDATE of the three reversal columns only; couli_readonly SELECT (D10-589). No backfill, no existing object changes, no business code: the writers and readers are B2-04zr. No trigger: the database does not by itself refuse a second reversal, because couli_app may update the reversal columns; that is held by the compare on reversed_at under the row lock in B2-04zr and by the voucher's uniq_key. platform takes the nine PlatformCode values of the contract. tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts only adds union_receipts to the funds-table expectation, as #2026 did for settle_runs (protected path, for the orchestrator's label).

reviews.note: round 1 (couli-runs/B2-04zh/money-review-r1.json), no findings. Static review, no tests run.

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude, static reading, not run by the reviewer. One S2 accepted: #5 and #12 would not catch a unique key widened with another column; the migration uses the exact keys. Its out_of_scope items (reversal once, voucher sides and signs, exposure after a reversal) are for B2-04zr, kept in couli-runs/B2-04zh/out-of-scope.md. The author ran twice: the first brief wrongly listed three platforms (the implementer's mistake, a truncated read of the enum), and the second round changed only [AC-B2-04zh#7] to the nine values of the contract.
